content: The aftershock sends gravel flying, like a fowlbeast shaking off water after a rain. It is quick, scattered, and unpredictable.

raw: Nowell did not even have time to check Clovisia for signs of life.
content: Nowell did not even have time to check Clovisia for signs of life.

speaker: Nowell
content: No...

raw: As the place threatens to shake itself apart, he bends over and protects the child from falling rocks with his own body. The sharper pieces easily pierce his clothes and skin, digging deep into flesh and bone.
content: As the place threatens to shake itself apart, he bends over and protects the child from falling rocks with his own body. The sharper pieces easily pierce his clothes and skin, digging deep into flesh and bone.

raw: He remains unmoving, clenching his teeth, waiting for the tremors to cease.
content: He remains unmoving, clenching his teeth, waiting for the tremors to cease.

raw: He is awakened from his pained trance by the sound of crying.
content: He is awakened from his pained trance by the sound of crying.

raw: The boy had awoken to find himself in a dark, unfamiliar underground space. Following his instincts, he began to cry helplessly.
content: The boy had awoken to find himself in a dark, unfamiliar underground space. Following his instincts, he began to cry helplessly.

speaker: Nowell
content: Good morning, Ollie.

raw: [name="Nowell"]It'll be okay. Everything will be okay. I'm here... it's Nowell.
speaker: Nowell
content: It'll be okay. Everything will be okay. I'm here... it's Nowell.

speaker: Nowell
content: *cough*, *cough*...

speaker: Nowell
content: We've met before, remember?

raw: The aftershocks cease. Carrying Ollie with one hand and supporting himself with the other, he forces himself to sit up, pushing the weight off his back.
content: The aftershocks cease. Carrying Ollie with one hand and supporting himself with the other, he forces himself to sit up, pushing the weight off his back.

raw: Fortunately, it is broken fragments of rock rather than a single, heavy slab, but he can still taste blood in his mouth as he moves.
content: Fortunately, it is broken fragments of rock rather than a single, heavy slab, but he can still taste blood in his mouth as he moves.

raw: In his arms, the child shakes his head helplessly in the darkness, hardly able to see anything.
content: In his arms, the child shakes his head helplessly in the darkness, hardly able to see anything.

speaker: Nowell
content: ...Clovisia.

raw: [name="Nowell"]She saved your life... I'll get you out safely.
speaker: Nowell
content: She saved your life... I'll get you out safely.

raw: [name="Nowell"]Then I'll come back... to bring her back. This is no resting place for her.
speaker: Nowell
content: Then I'll come back... to bring her back. This is no resting place for her.

raw: Nowell sits down, puts the trembling boy on the ground, and reaches behind to pull the fragments out from his own back.
content: Nowell sits down, puts the trembling boy on the ground, and reaches behind to pull the fragments out from his own back.
The boy grabs Nowell's clothes.

raw: [name="Nowell"]Don't worry, I'm not leaving you behind.
speaker: Nowell
content: Don't worry, I'm not leaving you behind.

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Shakes head)

speaker: Nowell
content: It's okay. It won't kill me.

speaker: Nowell
content: Nothing can.

raw: A smile, understood only by him, appears on his lips. Meanwhile, his fingers locate the final fragment, lodged between his scapula.
content: A smile, understood only by him, appears on his lips. Meanwhile, his fingers locate the final fragment, lodged between his scapula.

raw: He grits his teeth and pulls it out.
content: He grits his teeth and pulls it out.

speaker: Nowell
content: Argh...

speaker: Nowell
content: Did I spook you, Ollie? Sorry.

raw: [name="Nowell"]Don't worry. Come with me, and I'll get you out. Whatever it takes.
speaker: Nowell
content: Don't worry. Come with me, and I'll get you out. Whatever it takes.

raw: Enduring pain had become a habit. Nowell lifts the child again and searches his memory for a path that will take them to safety.
content: Enduring pain had become a habit. Nowell lifts the child again and searches his memory for a path that will take them to safety.

speaker: Nowell
content: I came from... this way.

raw: [name="Nowell"]Hang in there, Ollie. We'll get you out soon. Your parents are waiting—
speaker: Nowell
content: Hang in there, Ollie. We'll get you out soon. Your parents are waiting—

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Shakes head)

speaker: Nowell
content: What is it?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Struggles)

speaker: Nowell
content: Uh—

raw: [name="Nowell"]You want to get down? It's quicker and safer if I carry you. Don't you want to see your mum sooner?
speaker: Nowell
content: You want to get down? It's quicker and safer if I carry you. Don't you want to see your mum sooner?

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Jumps down)

raw: [name="Nowell"]...Alright. Stick close to me, and don't let go.
speaker: Nowell
content: ...Alright. Stick close to me, and don't let go.

raw: The child nods and grabs the corner of Nowell's clothes. He even wraps it around his palm tightly without being told, indicating that he understands Nowell.
content: The child nods and grabs the corner of Nowell's clothes. He even wraps it around his palm tightly without being told, indicating that he understands Nowell.

speaker: Nowell
content: Alright. Let's—
...You have walked a long path...
...Poor soul...

raw: Suddenly, he hears an ethereal voice echoing in every direction.
content: Suddenly, he hears an ethereal voice echoing in every direction.

raw: A mist spreads in the darkness, surrounding him.
content: A mist spreads in the darkness, surrounding him.
Why have you come?

raw: Nowell can recognize that voice anywhere.
content: Nowell can recognize that voice anywhere.

raw: He cannot move. A sudden, cold fury buffets his reason, nailing him to the spot.
content: He cannot move. A sudden, cold fury buffets his reason, nailing him to the spot.
What do you want?

speaker: Nowell
content: Stop.

raw: He does not know why the voice chose this moment to appear. Instinctive mistrust overcomes all judgment.
content: He does not know why the voice chose this moment to appear. Instinctive mistrust overcomes all judgment.

speaker: Nowell
content: Stop your parlor tricks.

raw: [name="???"]I thought you wanted to meet me.
content: I thought you wanted to meet me.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Nowell
content: What are you talking about?!

speaker: Nowell
content: Who are you? Where are you?

raw: [name="???"]I am here. You came for me, and I came for you.
content: I am here. You came for me, and I came for you.

raw: [name="???"]All you need to do... is open your eyes.
content: All you need to do... is open your eyes.

raw: Nowell has never seen the owner of the voice, nor gathered any clues about their appearance. Over the long years, all he could do was to piece together rumor after rumor, letting questions simmer into hatred.
content: Nowell has never seen the owner of the voice, nor gathered any clues about their appearance. Over the long years, all he could do was to piece together rumor after rumor, letting questions simmer into hatred.

raw: If this voice is real and not his imagination, then it must...
content: If this voice is real and not his imagination, then it must...

raw: [name="Nowell"]Is that so? Then I'm sure you can tell me...
speaker: Nowell
content: Is that so? Then I'm sure you can tell me...

raw: [name="Nowell"]Are you the wish-granting fairy? Or the powerful 'Nation's Sentinel'?
speaker: Nowell
content: Are you the wish-granting fairy? Or the powerful 'Nation's Sentinel'?

raw: The unicorn, hidden in the shadows of history, is both benefactor and villain.
content: The unicorn, hidden in the shadows of history, is both benefactor and villain.

raw: [name="Unicorn"]I am all that, and none of that.
speaker: Unicorn
content: I am all that, and none of that.

raw: [name="Unicorn"]I am merely here now to promise reparation to you, poor soul.
speaker: Unicorn
content: I am merely here now to promise reparation to you, poor soul.

raw: [name="Nowell"]You don't even know my name. What I went through must have been insignificant, hardly a footnote to a legend like you, compared to the affairs you've meddled with.
speaker: Nowell
content: You don't even know my name. What I went through must have been insignificant, hardly a footnote to a legend like you, compared to the affairs you've meddled with.

speaker: Unicorn
content: That is untrue.

raw: [name="Unicorn"]You harbored a possibility that I placed hope in. How would one little weed of unknown breed grow if it never wilts? And how will it affect the lands around it?
speaker: Unicorn
content: You harbored a possibility that I placed hope in. How would one little weed of unknown breed grow if it never wilts? And how will it affect the lands around it?

raw: [name="Unicorn"]That was my thought when I bestowed immortality upon you. What should have been a blessing.
speaker: Unicorn
content: That was my thought when I bestowed immortality upon you. What should have been a blessing.

speaker: Nowell
content: Blessing. Pft.

raw: [name="Nowell"]Your arrogant 'blessing' has brought me nothing but an eternity of pain.
speaker: Nowell
content: Your arrogant 'blessing' has brought me nothing but an eternity of pain.

speaker: Unicorn
content: ...That was not my intention.

raw: [name="Nowell"]But that's what it became. Death by a thousand cuts, except you wouldn't even let me die!
speaker: Nowell
content: But that's what it became. Death by a thousand cuts, except you wouldn't even let me die!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Nowell
content: It's nothing but a curse!

speaker: Unicorn
content: I understand your anger.

raw: [name="Unicorn"]Tell me. What will make you feel better?
speaker: Unicorn
content: Tell me. What will make you feel better?

speaker: Nowell
content: ...Hah.

speaker: Nowell
content: What, will you 'bestow' another 'blessing' upon me?

raw: Nowell can feel the child grab his clothes even tighter.
content: Nowell can feel the child grab his clothes even tighter.

speaker: Nowell
content: Can you hear me, Ollie?

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Nods)

raw: [name="Nowell"]This voice is a liar. Don't listen to it. Don't think about it.
speaker: Nowell
content: This voice is a liar. Don't listen to it. Don't think about it.

speaker: Nowell
content: I'll take you out of here.

raw: [name="Nowell"]Whoever you are, you can ask those legendary heroes who dance with you. Me, I'm leaving.
speaker: Nowell
content: Whoever you are, you can ask those legendary heroes who dance with you. Me, I'm leaving.

raw: [name="Unicorn"]Few are those who hold the helm in the tides of history.
speaker: Unicorn
content: Few are those who hold the helm in the tides of history.

speaker: Nowell
content: Are you complaining? To me?

raw: [name="Unicorn"]...If you consider my blessing a curse, I might offer you reparations.
speaker: Unicorn
content: ...If you consider my blessing a curse, I might offer you reparations.

raw: [name="Unicorn"]Make a wish. What is it that you want?
speaker: Unicorn
content: Make a wish. What is it that you want?

raw: [Subtitle(text="A name, thinks Nowell. Just a name. This bastard, this villain who stands ever on high because of her powers, has long forgotten the weed's name.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: A name, thinks Nowell. Just a name. This bastard, this villain who stands ever on high because of her powers, has long forgotten the weed's name.

raw: [name="Unicorn"]You have a chance... You have already gained much more than the common man.
speaker: Unicorn
content: You have a chance... You have already gained much more than the common man.

raw: [Subtitle(text="She must be filled with pity as she gazes upon me—", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: She must be filled with pity as she gazes upon me—

raw: [Subtitle(text="'You poor, insignificant creature. I will help you. I will help you, always.'", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: 'You poor, insignificant creature. I will help you. I will help you, always.'

raw: [Subtitle(text="'Let us wipe away the tragic past with a beautiful future.'", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: 'Let us wipe away the tragic past with a beautiful future.'

speaker: Nowell
content: Haha.

speaker: Unicorn
content: Have you made up your mind?

raw: [name="Nowell"]Let's go, Ollie. We've wasted enough time here.
speaker: Nowell
content: Let's go, Ollie. We've wasted enough time here.

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Grabs Nowell's clothes tightly)

speaker: Nowell
content: Yes, child, I'm here.

raw: [name="Nowell"]Don't be afraid of the voice. It's just a bad guy, no different from the ones ravaging the city above.
speaker: Nowell
content: Don't be afraid of the voice. It's just a bad guy, no different from the ones ravaging the city above.

raw: [name="Nowell"]I'll come back to catch it later. But first, I need to get you out.
speaker: Nowell
content: I'll come back to catch it later. But first, I need to get you out.

speaker: Nowell
content: Phew...

raw: [name="Excited Worker"]—It's Ollie! Mr. Nowell found him!
speaker: Excited Worker
content: —It's Ollie! Mr. Nowell found him!

speaker: Excited Worker
content: Over here! A hand!

speaker: Nowell
content: Careful, child.

raw: [name="Nowell"]I'll lift you up. Take it easy—
speaker: Nowell
content: I'll lift you up. Take it easy—

raw: [name="Excited Worker"]No worries, sir! I'm up here! I'll grab him!
speaker: Excited Worker
content: No worries, sir! I'm up here! I'll grab him!

raw: [name="Excited Worker"]Your turn, Mr. Nowell! Are you hurt? Do you need a hand?
speaker: Excited Worker
content: Your turn, Mr. Nowell! Are you hurt? Do you need a hand?

speaker: Nowell
content: No need.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Nowell clambers up friskily, but stops at the edge of the tunnel entrance rather than walking towards the crowd gathered not too far away.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Nowell clambers up friskily, but stops at the edge of the tunnel entrance rather than walking towards the crowd gathered not too far away.

raw: [Subtitle(text="He looks up again at the sun shrouded by thick clouds. It is one of countless sunrises he has seen, but this one is a little different, because of those who have lived to see it.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: He looks up again at the sun shrouded by thick clouds. It is one of countless sunrises he has seen, but this one is a little different, because of those who have lived to see it.

speaker: Panicked Woman
content: Ollie! My baby!

raw: [name="Panicked Woman"]Oh, the fright you gave me! Next time, I'm holding onto you and never letting go... I won't let this happen again!
speaker: Panicked Woman
content: Oh, the fright you gave me! Next time, I'm holding onto you and never letting go... I won't let this happen again!

raw: [name="Panicked Woman"]Wh-Where did this blood come from? Are you hurt?
speaker: Panicked Woman
content: Wh-Where did this blood come from? Are you hurt?

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Shakes head)

raw: [name="Panicked Woman"]Strange, I don't see any wounds...
speaker: Panicked Woman
content: Strange, I don't see any wounds...

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Looks at Nowell)

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Ollie, where's the lady who found you first? Is she still...
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Ollie, where's the lady who found you first? Is she still...

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Shakes head)

speaker: Anxious Man
content: She wasn't down there?

speaker: Quiet Child
content: (Shakes head)

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Oh, you're always like this... Well, it's all good. I'm so glad you came back safely.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Oh, you're always like this... Well, it's all good. I'm so glad you came back safely.

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Thank you so much, Mr. Nowell—
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Thank you so much, Mr. Nowell—

raw: The man waves at Nowell with something other than anxiety or panic on his face.
content: The man waves at Nowell with something other than anxiety or panic on his face.

raw: It is a smile of gratitude, with a sincerity that makes Nowell awkward. All he can do is nod and smile back.
content: It is a smile of gratitude, with a sincerity that makes Nowell awkward. All he can do is nod and smile back.

speaker: Nowell
content: You're... welcome...

raw: But the man keeps walking until he is right in front of him, and reaches out a hand, as though words alone cannot express his gratitude. And so Nowell keeps the smile on his face and shakes the extended hand, almost unconsciously.
content: But the man keeps walking until he is right in front of him, and reaches out a hand, as though words alone cannot express his gratitude. And so Nowell keeps the smile on his face and shakes the extended hand, almost unconsciously.

raw: Only then does he finally realize that pain is spreading, from his back to his chest to the rest of his body. He has difficulty breathing and bends down, grabbing his own collar.
content: Only then does he finally realize that pain is spreading, from his back to his chest to the rest of his body. He has difficulty breathing and bends down, grabbing his own collar.

raw: The wounds he received from the rubble have still not started to heal.
content: The wounds he received from the rubble have still not started to heal.

speaker: Anxious Man
content: —Sir? Are you okay?!

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]My goodness, your back! I didn't realize you were so badly injured—we have to find a doctor!
speaker: Anxious Man
content: My goodness, your back! I didn't realize you were so badly injured—we have to find a doctor!

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Oh, how silly of me, you're a doctor yourself...
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Oh, how silly of me, you're a doctor yourself...

speaker: Nowell
content: I'm... injured?

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Th-The wound on your back! It's still bleeding! It's so big... and there's more than one!
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Th-The wound on your back! It's still bleeding! It's so big... and there's more than one!

speaker: Nowell
content: Are they not healing yet?

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]N-No. That's normal for us, but I suppose it must be strange to you.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: N-No. That's normal for us, but I suppose it must be strange to you.

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]What happened down there? How did you get hurt?
speaker: Anxious Man
content: What happened down there? How did you get hurt?

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]That leader of the Self-Salvation Corps is down there too, isn't she?
speaker: Anxious Man
content: That leader of the Self-Salvation Corps is down there too, isn't she?

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]She protected Ollie. I have to do something for her... At least bring her body back.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: She protected Ollie. I have to do something for her... At least bring her body back.

speaker: Nowell
content: Clovisia.

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]Her name was Clovisia? That does ring a bell now that you mention it. I didn't even get a good look at her before it all happened.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: Her name was Clovisia? That does ring a bell now that you mention it. I didn't even get a good look at her before it all happened.

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]I heard she was a great woman.
speaker: Anxious Man
content: I heard she was a great woman.

raw: [Subtitle(text="I'm the leader of the Londinium Self-Salvation Corps. You can call me Clovisia.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I'm the leader of the Londinium Self-Salvation Corps. You can call me Clovisia.

raw: [Subtitle(text="'I am all that, and none of that.'", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: 'I am all that, and none of that.'

raw: [Subtitle(text="We cannot promise a reward either.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: We cannot promise a reward either.

raw: [Subtitle(text="'I am merely here now to promise reparation to you, poor soul.'", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: 'I am merely here now to promise reparation to you, poor soul.'

raw: [Subtitle(text="I'm afraid we don't have time to discuss this...", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: I'm afraid we don't have time to discuss this...

raw: [Subtitle(text="'Tell me. What will make you feel better?'", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: 'Tell me. What will make you feel better?'

speaker: Nowell
content: A great woman?

speaker: Nowell
content: Hah...

speaker: Nowell
content: I don't...

speaker: Nowell
content: I don't know.

raw: Clovisia... he had passed right by the one he spent his entire life looking for, without even realizing it.
content: Clovisia... he had passed right by the one he spent his entire life looking for, without even realizing it.

raw: But it is no longer important. With great effort, Nowell looks up, fighting against the pain and difficulty of breathing.
content: But it is no longer important. With great effort, Nowell looks up, fighting against the pain and difficulty of breathing.

raw: In his blurry vision, he sees a child clutching his mother's hand tightly. The boy is the very picture of health, his hair and skin a warm color, with a smile on his face, just like...
content: In his blurry vision, he sees a child clutching his mother's hand tightly. The boy is the very picture of health, his hair and skin a warm color, with a smile on his face, just like...

raw: [name="Anxious Man"]I-I'll take you to the Self-Salvation Corps! Or the Exemplars! They must have medics!
speaker: Anxious Man
content: I-I'll take you to the Self-Salvation Corps! Or the Exemplars! They must have medics!

speaker: Nowell
content: No...

speaker: Anxious Man
content: What? Why?

raw: [Subtitle(text="Just like the sun.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]

speaker: Anxious Man
content: M-Mr. Nowell! Are you okay?

speaker: Anxious Man
content: Hang in there!

raw: Nowell falls to his knees, no longer able to support his own weight. It is as though the fatigue of a hundred years of wandering has come upon him in an instant.
content: Nowell falls to his knees, no longer able to support his own weight. It is as though the fatigue of a hundred years of wandering has come upon him in an instant.

raw: Before his hands and feet grow cold from blood loss, he curls his body down, ignoring the searing pain as the wounds on his back stretch, until his head touches the ground.
content: Before his hands and feet grow cold from blood loss, he curls his body down, ignoring the searing pain as the wounds on his back stretch, until his head touches the ground.

raw: It is a posture of worship and reverence, but he is not praying to anyone.
content: It is a posture of worship and reverence, but he is not praying to anyone.

raw: He lifts his head after a little while.
content: He lifts his head after a little while.

raw: [name="Nowell"]The leader of the Self-Salvation Corps was not in the ruins.
speaker: Nowell
content: The leader of the Self-Salvation Corps was not in the ruins.

raw: The pain lingers, as does the urge to cry his heart out. But all is silent, and only the beating of the heart resonates in his chest.
content: The pain lingers, as does the urge to cry his heart out. But all is silent, and only the beating of the heart resonates in his chest.

raw: The thing that would make him happy, the thing that can kill him... it is already here.
content: The thing that would make him happy, the thing that can kill him... it is already here.

speaker: Anxious Man
content: What was that?

speaker: Nowell
content: Clovisia wasn't there.

speaker: Anxious Man
content: What about your injuries—

raw: [name="Nowell"]Right now, rather than spending my time on futile efforts...
speaker: Nowell
content: Right now, rather than spending my time on futile efforts...

raw: [name="Nowell"]I should spend it on saving more people.
speaker: Nowell
content: I should spend it on saving more people.
